findings.namedBuyers: No named individual could be verified as the Punta Cana edition organizer, planner, hotel buyer or contracting executive. Two verified named commercial contacts were not obtainable from the reviewed public sources. info@gotoapex.com is the verified edition-level team inbox; request introductions rather than assigning contract authority to ecosystem members or exhibitors.
findings.futureEdition: The edition-specific organizer page explicitly schedules February 18–21, 2027 in Punta Cana, Dominican Republic: February 18 is the trade-only B2B Travel Market; February 19 is trade/public; February 20–21 are public experience days. These are activity dates, corroborated by the organizer’s cities calendar, not article dates. Within the requested horizon. Organizer-announced, not independently verified as operationally secured; tickets are not yet on general sale.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference: prioritize a guestroom-led hosted-buyer, organizer or exhibitor accommodation package with small meetings or networking, rather than assuming the full public expo fits the resort. Wyndham’s official page confirms 620 rooms, three event rooms, 380 square meters, up to 300 conference or 200 banquet guests, and Uvero Alto beachfront/outdoor spaces. The event advertises ten travel worlds and both public and trade audiences but publishes no floor plan or attendance. Full-show feasibility requires technical review; accommodation potential is unquantified and depends on the eventual venue and transport.
findings.venueCommitments: The exact 2027 event page says “Venue to be announced.” No host hotel, lodging commitment or incumbent hotel is verified for this edition. This does not prove that contracting remains open. Do not infer a competing-hotel commitment from exhibitor lists, nearby hotel marketing or other APEX-branded shows.
findings.historicalRotation: No verified completed Punta Cana edition or recurring local host-hotel rotation was found. The same series advertised San Francisco October 8–11, 2026 and Miami October 22–25, 2026, but their edition pages still say venue to be announced. These are historical scheduled dates, not evidence the events actually occurred. The multi-city calendar establishes an advertised circuit, not an annual Punta Cana recurrence or rotating association congress.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Edition-specific enquiries, exhibiting, sponsorship and group tickets route to info@gotoapex.com. At platform level, Apex PCO describes venue sourcing and room-block/travel coordination through Apex Travel Clubs; the Travel Worlds ecosystem says stands, tickets and hotels run through one team. This is a credible routing lead, not evidence of an edition-specific hotel mandate, RFP, room block or open sourcing. No named Punta Cana PCO, DMC or accommodation buyer is verified.
findings.organizationStructure: Commercial event/expo ecosystem, not a verified association-owned congress. The official legal center identifies Apex Business Group Worldwide S.L., Spain, CIF B93697449, as the ecosystem legal operator and operator of Apex Events & Expos. VivaVita and Travel Worlds are event/platform branding. Apex also markets PCO and coordination services; that does not establish a separate appointed Punta Cana PCO or the final edition-specific contracting entity.
findings.competitiveLimitations: No sourced sellout, overflow requirement, incumbent room block or unmet room demand was found. Venue and attendee geography remain unknown, so transport practicality from Uvero Alto cannot be assessed. Hotel meeting capacity must not be equated with expo capacity. Under the supplied territory rules, any later Cap Cana, La Romana or Bayahibe venue would require a separate competitive-distance assessment, not automatic attribution of demand to this hotel.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Send a qualification-only introduction to info@gotoapex.com referencing February 18–21, 2027. Ask for the named edition producer and accommodation decision-maker, contracted venue/address, operational go-ahead, hotel-selection status, any appointed PCO/DMC, and room-night pattern, hosted-buyer count, budget and transport requirements. Offer a tailored all-inclusive buyer/organizer stay with small meeting or reception options subject to venue distance and availability. Request a floor plan before discussing full-show hosting. Do not quote an assumed block or buy exhibition space as a substitute for a lodging mandate. Keep as conditional relationship development pending ORS qualification.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: The 2027 edition is contactable through its published enquiry inbox, but access to a hotel procurement process is unconfirmed. Venue TBA and tickets not yet on general sale are not proof of open hotel sourcing. No evidence establishes demand already committed to another hotel, but no evidence establishes available inventory for Wyndham Alltra either.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: develop an Apex Travel Clubs/organizer relationship for this edition’s accommodation component and, only if a subsequent local edition is confirmed, later competitive capture. No Punta Cana 2028 dates or annual recurrence were verified. Do not present the worldwide circuit as guaranteed repeat demand for this resort.
